schubert-an-die-musik.tempoBasis: from four complete recordings, median 2:42 for both verses (Fischer-Dieskau/Moore 2:38, Bumbry/Werba 2:28, Baker/Parsons 2:47, Ameling/Baldwin 2:53), 1.5 s allowed for silence; Schubert marks it Mässig
schubert-an-die-musik.transcription: Transcribed by Mark Gotham from IMSLP #364857: holograph manuscript (1817).  Source: https://imslp.org/wiki/An_die_Musik,_D.547_(Schubert,_Franz)
